# Command-line reference

`colcon buildx`: Cross-compile ROS 2 workspace for embedded ARM boards.

Every option of `colcon buildx`, generated from its argument parser: the same source as `colcon buildx --help`. Any argument not listed here is passed on to `colcon build`.

Most options can also be set in a config file; [config keys](config-keys.md) lists them. The defaults shown apply when neither the command line nor the config file sets a value.

## Usage

```text
usage: colcon buildx [-h] [--method {docker,sysroot,sdk}] [--config CONFIG]
                     [--build-base BUILD_BASE] [--install-base INSTALL_BASE]
                     [--sysroot-host SYSROOT_HOST]
                     [--sysroot-mount SYSROOT_MOUNT] [--toolchain TOOLCHAIN]
                     [--no-mount] [--docker-image DOCKER_IMAGE]
                     [--docker-platform DOCKER_PLATFORM]
                     [--sync-from-device SSH_TARGET] [--use-base-image]
                     [--install-deps] [--rosdep-args ROSDEP_ARGS]
                     [--sdk-env SDK_ENV] [--emit-mixin]
                     [--install-deps-on-device SSH_TARGET] [--deploy]
                     [--deploy-target DEPLOY_TARGET] [colcon_args ...]
```

## Positional arguments

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `colcon_args` | Additional arguments to pass to colcon build (e.g., --packages-select my_package) |

## General options

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-h`, `--help` |  | show this help message and exit |
| `--method {docker,sysroot,sdk}` | `docker` | Build method: docker (container-based), sysroot (SSHFS mount), or sdk (Yocto/OpenEmbedded SDK on this host). Default: docker |
| `--config CONFIG` | unset | Configuration file (default: search for .buildx.conf or .buildx.yml in workspace) |
| `--build-base BUILD_BASE` | `cross_build` | Build directory for cross-compiled artifacts (default: cross_build) |
| `--install-base INSTALL_BASE` | `cross_install` | Install directory for cross-compiled artifacts (default: cross_install) |

## SSHFS Sysroot Options (--method sysroot)

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--sysroot-host SYSROOT_HOST` | unset | Hostname or IP of the target board for sysroot access (e.g., kria-vision-home) |
| `--sysroot-mount SYSROOT_MOUNT` | `~/mnt/board-sysroot` | Local mount point for board sysroot (default: ~/mnt/board-sysroot) |
| `--toolchain TOOLCHAIN` | unset | Path to CMake toolchain file (required for sysroot method) |
| `--no-mount` | `false` | Skip SSHFS mounting (assume sysroot already mounted) |

## Docker Options (--method docker)

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--docker-image DOCKER_IMAGE` | unset | Docker image for cross-compilation (e.g., ghcr.io/smarobix/smarobix-buildx-images:k26-jazzy) |
| `--docker-platform DOCKER_PLATFORM` | `linux/arm64` | Target platform for Docker (default: linux/arm64). Ignored for cross SDK images, which run on the host architecture. |
| `--sync-from-device SSH_TARGET` | unset | Sync package versions from target device (e.g., ubuntu@192.168.1.100). Creates local synced image. |
| `--use-base-image` | `false` | Force use of base image, skip auto-detection of synced images |
| `--install-deps` | `false` | Install workspace dependencies using rosdep in Docker image (for dev only, see --install-deps-on-device) |
| `--rosdep-args ROSDEP_ARGS` | `--ignore-src -y` | Additional arguments to pass to rosdep install (default: --ignore-src -y) |

## OE/Yocto SDK Options (--method sdk)

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--sdk-env SDK_ENV` | unset | Colon-separated list of SDK scripts to source, in order (e.g. /opt/ros-sdk/environment-setup-cortexa72-cortexa53-poky-linux) |
| `--emit-mixin` | `false` | Write a colcon mixin describing the SDK cross-build settings, for use with plain `colcon build --mixin` outside this extension |

## Device Dependency Options

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--install-deps-on-device SSH_TARGET` | unset | Install workspace dependencies on target device via SSH (e.g., ubuntu@10.42.0.3). Recommended before --sync-from-device. |

## Deployment Options

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--deploy` | `false` | Deploy build results to target board after successful build |
| `--deploy-target DEPLOY_TARGET` | unset | Deployment target in format user@host:/path/to/install (e.g., ubuntu@10.42.0.3:~/ros2_ws/install/) |
